statements.text: GET /tasks/count returns HTTP 200 with a JSON object of the shape { "count": <integer> }.
count equals the number of items returned by GET /tasks for the same store at the same moment.
Creating a task via POST /tasks (201) increases count by exactly 1.
Deleting a task via DELETE /tasks/{id} (204) decreases count by exactly 1.
GET / (health) and all existing /tasks CRUD behaviour are unchanged: the 5 baseline integration tests still pass.
The aggregate is computed at the endpoint boundary from the existing TaskStore read API; TaskStore's public shape is unchanged and Domain/** keeps no dependency on the HTTP layer (R-004, R-005).
